patches.description: Never auto-install a local Hermes Agent runtime in a packaged build; users configure the remote gateway explicitly. Keyed on app.isPackaged, not on a build-time env var.

Mirror an authorized local folder to the gateway host so a remote agent can read and write it. Uses only stock managed-files endpoints; no server patch required. Off unless local-workspace-bridge.json enables it.

Point the desktop update check at this repo's GitHub releases. Upstream's checkUpdates() only works against a git checkout, so packaged builds show "isn't a git checkout" instead of an update status. Report-only: it never downloads or swaps a build.
